observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for the message 'database <name> is not currently accepting connections' and its corresponding user-facing message.
observations.posthog_connection: This distinguishes a permanent database availability issue (e.g., paused Supabase project) from transient startup refusals, preventing the ingestion pipeline from repeatedly retrying a connection that will not succeed. This could reduce unnecessary retry attempts and provide clearer guidance to customers.
